summary: Build a complete Node.js bookstore API from scratch in a single repo with catalog, cart, checkout, and shipping—a well-defined implementation task that needs a concrete file plan before coding.

steps.why: Transform the ticket's detailed acceptance criteria into a structured Given/When/Then story with technical notes.
steps.instructions: Keep the AC granular and organized by capability: scaffold, health, catalog CRUD with auth, cart operations, checkout with stock validation, shipping with auth, persistence, and tests. Call out the SQLite schema creation on startup, x-role header auth pattern, and x-cart-id session tracking.

steps.why: Produce a complete file plan, database schema, route structure, and implementation sequence before any code is written.
steps.instructions: Design the SQLite schema with product, cart, cart_item, and order tables. Map each AC to specific Express routes with their handlers. Plan the project structure: package.json, src/server.js, src/routes/, src/db/, and tests/. Detail the auth middleware for x-role and cart resolution for x-cart-id. Outline the transaction handling for checkout (stock reduction + order creation).

steps.why: Map each acceptance criterion to a concrete test case covering health, catalog auth, cart flows, checkout validation, stock updates, shipping auth, and persistence.
steps.instructions: Create test cases for: API health check, admin-only book creation, shopper catalog read, cart item addition with auto-increment, quantity-above-stock rejection, cart item deletion, successful checkout with stock deduction and cart clear, checkout failure when stock is insufficient, admin-only shipping, shopper 403 on shipping, and persistence after restart.

steps.why: Verify the inline story, LLD, and test plan agree on the schema, routes, auth rules, cart semantics, and checkout transaction behavior.
Human approval of specs and this plan before Dev.

skipped.why: The ticket clearly defines scope, acceptance criteria, and what is out of scope; no ambiguity requiring product sign-off.
